replication_policy.unit: independent data-generating seed unless an artifact explicitly states otherwise
replication_policy.multiplicity: Holm correction within each declared primary family
replication_policy.uncertainty: paired bootstrap intervals for paired effects

experiments.command: uv run --frozen --extra baselines --extra dev python experiments/exp20_distribution_shift.py --quick --save-dir results/corrected_workshop/graph_label_sensitivity_smoke
experiments.claim: The protocol measures fixed-score graph-label sensitivity, not adaptation or distribution-shift robustness.

experiments.command: uv run --frozen --extra baselines --extra dev python experiments/exp22_intervention_control.py --seeds 10 --K 10 20 --T 300 --epochs 80 --device cpu --save-dir results/corrected_workshop/intervention_control
experiments.scope: 10 independent data seeds; target-aware, size-matched random forcing
experiments.claim: The bottleneck has small relative advantages over Lasso in these two configurations; this contrast does not establish a direct causal-information benefit.

experiments.command: uv run --frozen --extra baselines --extra dev python experiments/exp23_intervention_sweep.py --seeds 10 --K 10 20 --T 300 --int-types random constant soft --strengths 1 --baselines lasso ridge --epochs 80 --device cpu --save-dir results/corrected_workshop/intervention_semantics
experiments.scope: 10 independent data seeds; target-aware intervention-semantics comparison
experiments.claim: Constant clamps show no bottleneck relative advantage; selected random and soft effects are small and do not identify a bottleneck-specific mechanism.

experiments.command: uv run --frozen --extra baselines --extra dev python experiments/exp24_real_data_benchmark.py --datasets climate finance lorenz96 --methods Lagged-Bottleneck Lasso Ridge PCMCI PCMCI+ Granger --model-seeds 42 43 44 --epochs 80 --device cpu --save-dir results/corrected_workshop/real_data
experiments.scope: Climate and finance soft-label sensitivity; exact simulated Lorenz-96 graph
experiments.claim: Lagged bottleneck weights encode readable Lorenz-96 dependency signal, but Granger and tuned linear baselines recover the exact graph better in this configuration.

experiments.command: uv run --frozen --extra baselines --extra dev python experiments/exp25_causal_baselines.py --seeds 10 --K-values 10 20 --T-values 300 --epochs 80 --device cpu --save-dir results/corrected_workshop/intervention_methods
experiments.scope: 10 independent data seeds; target-aware random forcing
experiments.claim: All four tested methods have positive within-method gains. A direct exploratory Granger-minus-Bottleneck contrast is null at K=10 and positive at K=20 after Holm correction.

experiments.scope: 10 independent data seeds; K in {10,20}; T in {300,600}; nonlinearity mix in {0,0.2,0.3,0.4,0.6,1}
experiments.claim: No common-T mild-nonlinearity regime passes the fixed gate; the isolated K=20,T=300 effect is invariant to nonlinearity and disappears at T=600.
